name: winterscode

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-asset-versions.mjs && astro build && node scripts/csp-postprocess.mjs

browserslistReason: S283. Tailwind v4 runs Lightning CSS, which without a declared target emits Media Queries Level 4 range syntax and drops the -webkit-backdrop-filter prefix. Measured against the live Astro 6 build across 44 pages: 3392 min-width queries became range syntax, which Safari understands from 16.4, and 252 backdrop-filter prefixes became 209. An iPhone on iOS 15 would have received no responsive CSS at all. The Tailwind plugin does not read this key, so the same floor is declared in the Vite config, and this is the record of why.
